temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn for several days during a busy, stressful week at the bank. When Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed Marilyn's unusual quietness was out of character and likely meant something was bothering her, though she did not know what.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's response confirms that her quietness is tied to work and personal stress rather than to Carolyn or simple rudeness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is dealing with significant work and personal stress, appreciates Carolyn's concern, but has not shared details and may not be ready to.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and somewhat relieved that Marilyn acknowledged the issue.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and remain available to listen, while respecting Marilyn's boundaries and not prying.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn had responded curtly in a later interaction, which confused and hurt Carolyn. Carolyn shares her own tough experiences and says talking can help. Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has just been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed she may have overstepped or that Marilyn was upset with her because of the curt response.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's apology and explanation show the curtness was due to a hard week, not personal rejection, and that Carolyn's openness was appreciated.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is receptive to Carolyn's support, the misunderstanding is not personal, and their connection can recover and develop.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and hurt, then relieved, empathetic, and somewhat reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear up any misunderstanding and continue showing support through open, supportive communication.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appeared to respond positively to Carolyn's previous openness. Carolyn invites her to a small weekend gathering, and Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn felt relieved and hopeful about their budding friendship, believing Marilyn might be warming to a closer connection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's acceptance confirms she is interested in engaging socially and strengthening the friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is willing to connect outside work, and the friendship is strengthening.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Strengthen the bond by hosting the gathering and continuing to build the friendship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives that Marilyn still maintains a professional distance at the bank. In a direct conversation, Marilyn says she did not realize this, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed their relationship was improving, but she now perceives a work-place distance and may believe Marilyn is keeping her at arm's length professionally.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn was not intentionally distant, is open to discussing the issue, and is willing to improve their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The work dynamic still needs to be addressed, but Marilyn has acknowledged Carolyn's concern and is willing to talk, so the issue may be resolvable.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed, confused, and hurt, then somewhat reassured and cautiously hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Address the work dynamic directly, understand the distance, and work toward better professional collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. She proposes teaming up on a new project proposal, and Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they talked, and looks forward to working more closely together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed they had cleared the air and gained a better mutual understanding of professional expectations and personal boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms mutual interest in closer collaboration and reinforces that their relationship is on solid footing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They have a stronger, more understanding partnership, and Marilyn is willing to work closely with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up on the new project proposal and continue strengthening their collaborative partnership.
